name: @repo/input-validation
description: InputValidation - checks input from outside the app against a zod schema. Framework-free, so the browser may use it too.

scripts.dev: tsc --build tsconfig.build.json && concurrently -n tsc,alias "tsc --build tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json --watch"
